user.title: Viark satellite receiver
user.description: Enter the address of your Viark receiver. It must be powered on or in soft standby; in deep standby it drops off the network entirely.

data_description.host: The receiver's IP address, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.port: The control port. Leave at 20000 unless you have changed it.

reconfigure.title: Change the receiver's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the new address of your Viark receiver. It must be powered on or in soft standby.

data_description.host: The receiver's IP address, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.port: The control port. Leave at 20000 unless you have changed it.

error.cannot_connect: Could not talk to a Viark receiver at that address. Check the IP, make sure the receiver is not in deep standby, and confirm port 20000 is reachable.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The receiver's address has been updated.
abort.wrong_device: That address belongs to a different receiver. To add it, set it up as a new device instead.

cannot_connect.message: Cannot reach the Viark receiver at {host}: {error}

update_failed.message: Error talking to the Viark receiver: {error}

no_state.message: The Viark receiver returned no state.

key_rejected.message: The Viark receiver rejected the key: {error}

power_refused.message: The Viark receiver refused the power command: {error}

unknown_key.message: Unknown Viark key "{key}". Use a raw key code number or one of: {keys}

negative_key.message: Key code must not be negative: "{key}"

send_key.name: Send key
send_key.description: Inject a remote-control key code into the receiver.

key.name: Key
key.description: A key name (mute, power, epg, menu, volume_up, digit_7, ...) or a raw numeric key code.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to send the key.
